source: Trader-provided FVG transcript plus explicit trader TP clarification on 2026-08-17

detector_authority.rule: Use the existing native detector; do not maintain a second strategy-specific FVG detector.

fvg_identity.bullish: third candle low is strictly above first candle high
fvg_identity.bearish: third candle high is strictly below first candle low
fvg_identity.zone_boundaries: wick-to-wick price band between candle one and candle three
fvg_identity.active_target_gap: formed and not subsequently re-entered/mitigated on a completed later 15m bar

trader_target_rule.purpose: FVG is one possible take-profit reaction destination, not an automatic winner over nearer liquidity.
trader_target_rule.fvg_take_profit: middle of the selected active 15m FVG, tick rounded conservatively
trader_target_rule.liquidity_cluster_take_profit: safe middle/interior of the selected meaningful liquidity cluster
trader_target_rule.tiny_weak_shelf: may be skipped only when it fails the existing meaningful-reaction quality gate

video_entry_filters.adoption_rule: Do not silently turn the video's full six-factor FVG-entry checklist into hard current-strategy entry rules. The trader supplied this video so the bot knows FVG identity and explicitly confirmed the current 15m TP role. Existing user-confirmed FVG entry/context semantics remain unchanged unless separately confirmed.
